description: Converge AgentSessionQuerier's internal static surface: move DTO projections to a dedicated mapper, record pure reads to AgentSessionRecord instance methods, transcript reductions to the transcript region, and issue-title lookup to the Issue read side, so the querier ends up with zero internal static members.

tasks.title: Extract AgentSessionDtoMapper (DTO projections + authoritative Labels helper)
tasks.description: Add `internal static class AgentSessionDtoMapper` in `Sessions/Services/` housing all session DTO projections — `ToUsageDto` (AgentSession, AgentUsageSummary, and the summary+history overloads), `BuildUsageHistoryDto`, `ToEventSummaryDto`, `BuildLineageDto`, `ToProjection` — plus the single authoritative `Labels(params (string Key, string? Value)[])` ordinal dictionary builder. Re-target the three consumers (AgentSessionQuerier private helpers, AgentActivityFeedAssembler, AgentUsageReporter) to call the mapper, delete the byte-for-byte duplicate `Labels` at AgentActivityFeedAssembler.cs:302-311, then remove the six corresponding statics (`ToUsageDto`, `BuildUsageHistoryDto`, `ToEventSummaryDto`, `BuildLineageDto`, `ToProjection`, `Labels`) from AgentSessionQuerier. Re-target the 8 direct static calls in AgentSessionRecoveryDomainSpecs.cs (BuildLineageDto ×3, BuildUsageHistoryDto ×3, ToUsageDto ×2) to the mapper with no assertion changes, and add the three cross-consumer identity specs (usage DTO querier-vs-assembler, event-summary DTO querier-vs-assembler, lineage metadata-path-vs-generic-summary-path) that codify the byte-alignment invariant.
acceptanceCriteria: AgentSessionDtoMapper exists in packages/server/src/Mohist.Server/Sessions/Services/ as an internal static type exposing ToUsageDto (all overloads), BuildUsageHistoryDto, ToEventSummaryDto, BuildLineageDto, ToProjection, and Labels.

AgentSessionQuerier no longer declares ToUsageDto, BuildUsageHistoryDto, ToEventSummaryDto, BuildLineageDto, ToProjection, or Labels as internal static members; its private DTO construction delegates to AgentSessionDtoMapper.
AgentActivityFeedAssembler no longer declares a local Labels builder; AgentUsageReporter and the querier obtain label-filter dictionaries from AgentSessionDtoMapper.Labels.

DTO output is byte-identical to the pre-change output: context-exhaustion/suspected flags remain null (not false) when unmatched; BuildUsageHistoryDto returns null for empty/absent ContextUsageHistory; text/reasoning parts project to serialized { text } while other part types pass through verbatim (covered by existing byte-identity specs plus new identity specs).
New cross-consumer identity specs assert identical AgentUsageDto, AgentEventSummaryDto, and RuntimeSessionLineageEntryDto lists across querier/assembler/generic-summary paths for identical input.
`npm test` (server) is green; the 8 re-targeted calls in AgentSessionRecoveryDomainSpecs.cs compile and pass with unchanged assertions.
`rg "ToUsageDto|BuildUsageHistoryDto|ToEventSummaryDto|BuildLineageDto|ToProjection" packages/server/src` shows these projection methods only on AgentSessionDtoMapper, not on AgentSessionQuerier.
tasks.output: packages/server/src/Mohist.Server/Sessions/Services/AgentSessionDtoMapper.cs; updated AgentSessionQuerier.cs, AgentActivityFeedAssembler.cs, AgentUsageReporter.cs; updated/new specs under packages/server/tests/Mohist.Server.Tests/Specs/Sessions/
tasks.notes: Follow the design's additive-first sub-strategy within this task: introduce the mapper + Labels first (build green), then swap the three consumers, then delete the six statics, keeping the build green at each sub-step. Keep the mapper pure (no DB, no clock, no DI) to match the IssueRowMapper/WorkflowStatusMapper precedent.

tasks.title: Move Label/IssueNumber to AgentSessionRecord instance methods and remove the Annotation forwarder
tasks.description: Add instance methods on `AgentSessionRecord` for label-with-metadata-fallback and issue-number parsing. Per design Open Question 1 (lean a), make `Label(string key)` perform the record-first-then-metadata fallback (`Labels[key] ?? Session.Metadata.Label(key)`) so the ~17 sibling call sites get the cleanest name with no production-visible change (production records are built with session.Metadata.Labels, so dictionaries coincide). Add `IssueNumber()` parsing the resolved issue-number label as int (0 on absent/empty/whitespace/non-numeric). Re-target AgentSessionQuerier, AgentActivityFeedAssembler, AgentSessionContextRefs, and collapse the private Label/IssueNumber duplicates at WorkflowActivityQuerier.cs:118-124 to the record methods. Remove the `Annotation` static forwarder and inline `session.Metadata.Annotation(key)` at its three querier call sites (ToSummaryDto, BuildSessionMetadataDtoAsync ×2). Remove the three statics (Label, IssueNumber, Annotation) from AgentSessionQuerier.
acceptanceCriteria: AgentSessionRecord exposes a label accessor that resolves record labels first then falls back to Session.Metadata labels, and an IssueNumber() instance method returning the parsed int (0 for absent/non-numeric).

Record-precedence, metadata-fallback, and absent-returns-null scenarios pass: when a key is on both record and metadata labels with different values the record value wins; when absent from record but present on metadata the metadata value is returned; when absent from both the result is null.
WorkflowActivityQuerier.cs:118-124 private Label/IssueNumber duplicates are removed and replaced with the record instance methods.

AgentSessionQuerier no longer declares static Label(AgentSessionRecord,string), IssueNumber(AgentSessionRecord), or Annotation(AgentSession,string); annotation reads go through session.Metadata.Annotation(key).
RunnerRoutes.cs:362-363 observe identical label values (verified via the existing AgentSessionContextAssociationApiSpecs, since production records share the metadata label dictionary).
`npm test` (server) is green with no behavior change to HTTP responses.
tasks.output: Updated AgentSessionQuery.cs (AgentSessionRecord), AgentSessionQuerier.cs, AgentActivityFeedAssembler.cs, AgentSessionContextRefs.cs, WorkflowActivityQuerier.cs; updated/new specs under packages/server/tests/Mohist.Server.Tests/Specs/Sessions/
tasks.notes: Confirm the Label naming choice (lean: make Label(key) do the fallback, drop any WithFallback suffix) in the implementation. Document the fallback semantics in the method XML doc. Additive-first: add the instance method, swap callers, then delete the statics.

tasks.title: Relocate transcript reductions (LoadEventSummariesAsync, ReconcileActiveSessionsAsync) to TranscriptReductions
tasks.description: Add `internal static class TranscriptReductions` in `Sessions/Services/` peer to TranscriptPartLoader.cs, moving LoadEventSummariesAsync and ReconcileActiveSessionsAsync together with their private helpers (LoadWorkflowRunsForReconciliationAsync, DeserializeWorkflowRun, IsSessionAssociatedWithRun, IsActiveSession). The reductions consume AgentSessionDtoMapper.ToProjection (from T-001) for projecting parts and AgentSessionRecord label-with-fallback (from T-002) for reading WorkflowRunId/WorkId labels during reconciliation. Re-target AgentSessionQuerier and AgentActivityFeedAssembler to call TranscriptReductions, and remove the two statics (LoadEventSummariesAsync, ReconcileActiveSessionsAsync) from AgentSessionQuerier. Verify the existing AgentSessionRecoveryDomainSpecs / AgentActivityFeedAssemblerSpecs exercise both branches (active-non-matching, unassigned-provisional, non-active passthrough).
acceptanceCriteria: TranscriptReductions exists peer to TranscriptPartLoader.cs and houses LoadEventSummariesAsync and ReconcileActiveSessionsAsync with their private helpers; TranscriptPartLoader.LoadAsync stays untouched (raw-materials contract preserved).

Event-summary batch computation is byte-identical to the pre-change output: empty session-id input yields an empty dictionary, sessions with no transcript parts are absent from the result, and each session's parts are projected and ordered by (sequence, id).

Active-session reconciliation filters identically: non-active sessions (no bound AgentSessionId) pass through unchanged, active sessions bound to a different runner or with a non-matching work id are excluded, and unassigned workflow runs provisionally accept active sessions.

AgentSessionQuerier no longer declares LoadEventSummariesAsync or ReconcileActiveSessionsAsync as internal static members; querier and assembler obtain identical reconciliation/summary results by invoking the same relocated reduction.
`npm test` (server) is green; existing reconciliation/summary specs pass unchanged.
tasks.notes: Do not put these on TranscriptPartLoader itself (breaks its raw-materials-only contract) and do not move reconciliation to the Workflow read side (session-surfaceing decision stays a Session read concern). The reductions take MohistDbContext as a parameter, keeping them testable via the in-memory test DB factory.

tasks.title: Relocate issue-title batch lookup to IssueTitleLookup on the Issue read side
tasks.description: Add `internal static class IssueTitleLookup` in `Issue/Services/` exposing `LoadTitlesAsync(db, projectId, issueNumbers, ct) -> Dictionary<int, string>` (loads issue rows via IssueRowMapper.ByNumber, deduplicates numbers, returns empty dict without querying the DB for empty input) and `Resolve(titles, issueNumber) -> string` (returns the stored title when non-whitespace, else the literal `Issue #{number}`). Re-target AgentSessionQuerier.ListCurrentAsync and AgentActivityFeedAssembler to call IssueTitleLookup with the (db, project, numbers) tuple, and remove the two statics (LoadIssueTitlesAsync, IssueTitle) from AgentSessionQuerier. Verify both querier and assembler obtain identical number->title maps.
acceptanceCriteria: IssueTitleLookup exists in packages/server/src/Mohist.Server/Issue/Services/ and exposes LoadTitlesAsync and Resolve; IssueRowMapper remains a pure row->domain mapper with no DB access added.

Batch lookup is identical to the pre-change output: empty issue-number input returns an empty dictionary without querying the database; duplicate numbers are deduplicated so each distinct number is looked up once.
Single-title resolver returns the stored title verbatim when non-whitespace, and falls back to the literal `Issue #{number}` byte-identically when absent or whitespace.
AgentSessionQuerier no longer declares LoadIssueTitlesAsync or IssueTitle as internal static members; querier and assembler share the same Issue read-side capability.
`npm test` (server) is green with no behavior change to HTTP responses.
tasks.output: packages/server/src/Mohist.Server/Issue/Services/IssueTitleLookup.cs; updated AgentSessionQuerier.cs, AgentActivityFeedAssembler.cs; specs under packages/server/tests/Mohist.Server.Tests/Specs/Sessions/ and/or Issue/
tasks.notes: Do not add this to IssueQuerier (too heavy: full enrich surface) or IssueRowMapper (too pure: no DB). Matches the architecture rule of placing cross-domain read queries on the domain that owns the data.

tasks.title: Verify zero-statics invariant, repoint doc references, and run full gates
tasks.description: After all four functional modules land, perform the global verification the design's step 6 and verification gates require: confirm AgentSessionQuerier has zero internal static members, repoint any remaining `<see cref>` references to removed statics to the new homes (notably `AgentActivityFeedAssembler.cs:22-23`, whose `<see cref="AgentSessionQuerier.ReconcileActiveSessionsAsync"/>` / `<see cref="AgentSessionQuerier.LoadEventSummariesAsync"/>` references are re-pointed as part of T-003's assembler re-targeting), and run the full server/web test gates. Note: files like AgentSessionContextRefs.cs, AgentSessionContextRefsSpecs.cs, GenericAgentSessionSummarySpecs.cs, and AgentSessionReadModels.cs only reference NON-removed AgentSessionQuerier members (e.g. BuildAgentSessionListContextRefs, BuildGenericSessionSummaryContextRefs, GetGenericSessionSummaryAsync) and require no repointing.
acceptanceCriteria: `rg "internal static.*AgentSessionQuerier|AgentSessionQuerier\.(Build|Load|To|Issue|Label|Annotation|Reconcile|Labels)\b" packages/server/src` returns zero non-doc-comment hits.
`rg "record.Label\(|Session.Metadata.Label\b|private static.*Labels\(" packages/server/src` returns no additional undiscovered duplicates of the label/labels helpers.

Any `<see cref>` references to the removed statics (notably the `<see cref="AgentSessionQuerier.ReconcileActiveSessionsAsync"/>` / `<see cref="AgentSessionQuerier.LoadEventSummariesAsync"/>` references in AgentActivityFeedAssembler.cs, repointed as part of T-003) are repointed to AgentSessionDtoMapper / AgentSessionRecord / TranscriptReductions / IssueTitleLookup as appropriate.
`npm test` (server) full spec suite is green, including the byte-identity specs for usage / event-summary / lineage / history and the new cross-consumer identity specs.
`npm run typecheck -w packages/web` and `npm run test:run -w packages/web` are green (unchanged inputs/outputs).
tasks.output: Repointed doc references; verification command output showing zero statics and green test suites
tasks.notes: This is the integration gate for the global acceptance criterion 'internal static 成员数降为零'. Rollback point per design: the commit before T-001's static deletion, since statics existed as forwarders through the additive/swap sub-steps.
